name: Video Wallpaper Optimizer
description: Plays video wallpapers through skwd-wall's renderer instead of inside the shell. Ambxst keeps its picker, library, per-screen choices and matugen colours; only the playback moves out. skwd decodes a video once for every screen with zero-copy presentation, which measured at about half the video-decoder load, a quarter of the CPU and roughly 450 MB less VRAM than Ambxst's QtMultimedia player on a 4K wallpaper across two monitors. When no screen shows a video, skwd is stopped and Ambxst draws images (and their transitions) itself. Needs skwd-wall's skwd-deck and skwd-paper installed; without them, or if skwd fails, videos play in Ambxst as before.
author: drpezzer
permissions: Starts and stops your skwd-walld user service (systemctl --user) while a screen shows a video wallpaper
Tells skwd which wallpaper each screen shows, and pauses or resumes it, with skwd-helm
